domain.description: The brand's domain, normalised (no scheme, www or path); null when none was given

category.description: The category used for the questions; null when you gave your own questions without one

promptIndex.description: Position of the question in this run, starting at 1

engine.description: The engine id, as given in the input

model.description: The model id that answered (or would have answered, on an error row)

status.description: ok = an answer came back (one charged result); error = it did not (see errorCode), not charged

errorCode.description: timeout, rate_limited, quota_exhausted, provider_error, engine_not_configured, budget_cap or charge_limit; null when status is ok

mentioned.description: true when the brand (or an alias) is named in the answer by the matching rules; decided by text matching, not by an AI; null on error

mentionType.description: listed = named in a list, bold text, heading or table; prose = named in running text; none = not named; null on error

rank.description: Position of the brand in the list the answer gives (1 = first); null when not mentioned or not in a list

listLength.description: How many brands the answer lists, the brand included; null when no list was found

competitorCount.description: How many other brands the answer names, up to 15; a count only, no names. null on error

brandCited.description: true when one of the engine's cited URLs is on the brand's domain; the URLs themselves are not exported; null on error or without a domain

searchUsed.description: true when the engine ran a web search for this answer; false means it answered from memory; null on error

sentiment.description: positive, neutral or negative: an AI judgement of the answer's tone toward the brand, not a measurement; null when not mentioned or when the simple list parser was used

extraction.description: llm = competitors and rank read by a small model; heuristic = by a simple list parser; null on error

latencyMs.description: Milliseconds the engine took to answer; null on error
